title: Space-at-Scale MCP Server as SCWs
structural_note: The server is the bounded object. Data feeds it the way energy fills a universe; the law registry and the field SCWs tell each region how to turn that data into structure. Everything marked PROPOSED is Human0's design for the next build: a massless instruction field located at each galaxy, with dark matter used as its carrier. The rest exists in v0.15.0.

scws.name: Space-at-Scale MCP Server
scws.role: the container every SCW runs inside; nothing in it can be told apart without the server
scws.holds: server.js (25 tools), universe.js (SCW graph), physics-core.js and galaxy-core.js (shared byte-for-byte with the app), stdio and HTTP transports, public mode

laws.text: Public mode: return generated state, persist nothing
App and server load the same physics bytes

scws.name: Law registry
scws.role: sets which laws apply in each SCW and whether each is inherited or locally checked
scws.holds: 20 laws: Q1-Q3 quantum, S0-S1 structural, P1-P5 physical, C1-C2 chemistry, E1-E4 and G1-G3 emergent; inherit or local rules

laws.text: inherit laws pass down every parent chain
local laws are re-checked in each SCW

scws.name: Catalog data
scws.role: raw matter for every scale; built deterministically from published catalogs
scws.holds: galaxy.json (4,240 systems, 391 GW events), stars.json (3,665 stars), solar elements and routes in physics-core.js; build-galaxy.js

laws.text: every value carries its source; inconsistent rows are dropped, not repaired

scws.name: Evals and parity
scws.role: refuses any state that breaks a law or the byte parity between app and server
scws.holds: run_evals (77/77 in our universe, 96/96 with three), validate_app_dropin, release.js provenance check

laws.text: no release unless every eval passes

scws.name: Tool and view surface
scws.role: the 25 tools and the MCP App view; the only doors into the graph
scws.holds: open_space_at_scale (view); scw_get, scw_children, scw_search, scw_relations (graph); sim_state, sim_clock, events, remove_state (state)

laws.text: tools read the graph; only state tools change it, and every change is removable

scws.name: SCW0 multiverse harness
scws.role: holds universes; shares quantum laws, never physical constants
scws.holds: generate_universe, generate_exotic_universe, hidden universes

laws.text: Q1-Q3 unitarity, superposition, uncertainty
physical constants

scws.name: Dark matter field (instruction carrier)
scws.tag: PROPOSED; massless, located at the galactic center
scws.role: holds the local instructions for how gravity turns data into the Milky Way and Sgr A*, so an agent writing into SCW4 knows the data types, recursion limits and output contract
scws.holds: location: galactocentric origin; mass: none; instruction set for SCW4 and Sgr A*: data types, units, integrator and step limits, balance checks (energy, angular momentum, bound fraction) that stop a bang, pop or poof

laws.text: carries no mass; acts only by setting laws
reject any write that unbalances energy or angular momentum beyond tolerance

one_line: The Space-at-Scale server is one bounded SCW: catalog data feeds it, the law registry and evals govern it, and SCW0 holds our universe down to the solar system. The proposed dark matter field is a massless SCW at the galactic center that governs how the Milky Way and Sgr A* are built from that data. Three of the six specialist areas have no good Context Plane skill yet, so a Space-at-Scale topic pack comes before the agent loops.
